$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; tracks the private design/spec/energy-receipt-v0.1.md and the private design/adr/0093-energy-anchored-action-receipts.md. One record per consequential agent action in energy-receipts.jsonl inside a Run Capsule. Core principle: measured-or-declared-unknown, NEVER fabricated.
title: EnergyReceipt
description: An Energy-Anchored Action Receipt: a signed record of MEASURED (or honestly-declared-unknown) energy in joules, carbon in gCO2e, and provenanced grid intensity for one consequential agent action. Additive in-capsule JSONL stream (ADR-0093); NOT a third top-level format (ADR-0034).

schema_version.description: Energy receipt schema version. Must be 0.1.x for this revision (ADR-0093 §A0).

receipt_id.description: Unique within the capsule. 26-char Crockford base32 ULID, time-sortable.

kind.description: What kind of action this receipt accounts for.

id.description: The id of the accounted action: a model_call_id / tool_call_id ULID, a Slurm job-step id, or a run_id.

action_ref.description: Join key. Binds this receipt to exactly one action elsewhere in the capsule.

run_id.description: The run this action belongs to. Equals the capsule's run_id.

capsule_id.description: The capsule this receipt lives in (capsule Merkle root or capsule id).

measured_joules.description: MEASURED energy attributed to this action, in joules. MUST be null when no measurement is available or when energy is declared rather than measured. NEVER a fabricated estimate written as if measured (ADR-0093 forgery-guard).

measurement_source.description: The physical or declared source of the energy figure. 'declared_*' sources MUST set confidence='declared'; 'unavailable' MUST set confidence='unknown' and measured_joules=null.

measurement_scope.description: The hardware boundary the raw counter integrates over, before attribution down to this action.

wall_clock_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the action in seconds; the integration window for power-to-energy.

integrator.description: How point samples were integrated to energy. 'counter_delta' for monotonic energy counters (RAPL, NVML total-energy, sacct).

sampling.description: How the energy was integrated. Present for measured/apportioned receipts; omit for declared/unavailable.

confidence.description: Honesty grade. 'measured' = direct counter at action scope; 'apportioned' = a coarser measured total shared down to this action; 'declared' = a published-table figure, not measured here; 'unknown' = no figure (measured_joules=null).

value.description: The uncertainty magnitude: a fraction (relative), a joule magnitude (absolute), or a [low, high] joule interval.

basis.description: Plain-text justification of the error figure (e.g. 'RAPL package quantization', 'time-share apportionment of node total').

error_model.description: Quantified uncertainty of measured_joules. Honest about the apportionment error this receipt carries.

attribution_method.description: How a coarser measured total was shared down to this action. 'direct_counter' = no apportionment needed; 'none' = nothing measured.

attribution_basis.description: Plain-text description of the apportionment fraction and how it was derived (e.g. 'this process used 0.42 of node CPU-seconds in the window').

idle_baseline_j.description: Idle/baseline energy over the same window, subtracted (or recorded) so dynamic energy is separable. Null when no baseline was measured.

carbon_g_co2e.description: Operational carbon for this action in grams CO2-equivalent = measured_joules / 3.6e6 * grid_intensity_g_per_kwh. MUST be null when measured_joules is null or grid intensity is unavailable. NEVER fabricated.

grid_intensity_g_per_kwh.description: Grid carbon intensity used, in grams CO2e per kWh. Null when no provenanced signal is available.

region.description: Grid region / balancing-authority code the intensity applies to.

method.description: How the intensity figure was obtained. Marginal vs average is recorded because it materially changes the carbon claim (arXiv 2308.06680).

retrieved_at.description: When the intensity signal was fetched (RFC 3339).

signal_url.description: Provenance URL of the signal, when applicable.

double_count_guard.description: Guard against the double-counting failure mode (up to 66% double-counting, arXiv 2308.06680). 'market_certificate_id' records the retired-certificate id for market-based claims.

grid_intensity_source.description: Provenance of the grid-intensity figure. Present whenever grid_intensity_g_per_kwh is non-null.

carbon_accounting_mode.description: GHG Protocol accounting mode. 'unknown' when no carbon figure is produced (carbon_g_co2e=null).

node_id.description: Hostname or node identifier the action ran on.

accelerator_kind.description: Accelerator class present on the node.

gpu_uuid.description: NVML/vendor GPU UUID when an accelerator was used.

tdp_watts.description: Thermal design power of the relevant device, for the declared_tdp degraded path only.

counters_available.description: The energy counters actually readable on this node at capture time. FORGERY-GUARD: a receipt with confidence='measured' MUST have a non-empty counters_available consistent with measurement_source (verified by `nova energy verify`).

hardware.description: Hardware context. counters_available is the ground truth the forgery-guard checks against.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical bytes of this receipt MINUS the seal block. The agent hot path emits only this hash; the finalizer/collector signs it (ADR-0093 §A3, no heavy crypto in the hot path).

signed.description: Whether this receipt has been bound into a DSSE envelope yet.

dsse_envelope_ref.description: Path/ref to the DSSE envelope carrying the in-toto energy predicate over this receipt's payload_hash.

merkle_leaf_hash.description: This receipt's leaf in the capsule/collector Merkle log.

seal.description: Seal binding. Absent or signed=false until the finalizer/collector binds the receipt (ADR-0041 NovaSeal).

generated_at.description: When this receipt record was generated (RFC 3339, UTC).
